tonight.headline: 46% — and Golden is still on your bench
body: Bad news first: Tuten's ankle is a high sprain he has managed since Week 8, and Coen will only say 'We'll see' (Roundtable via Yahoo, 25 Nov). Jacobs is questionable for tonight, but LaFleur is 'not anticipating' him playing (SI 24 Nov); ESPN projects 0.0. Boswell's kicks now come from Mason Rudolph's offence. You are 3-8.

JuiceJam started Kenneth Walker III (21.4) at 05:10 UTC; he was limited Tuesday and is trending toward playing (CBS 24 Nov). ESPN now has it 126.2 to 134.9, 46%. Golden (16.7) still sits behind Gordon (14.0) and kicks off at 19:00 CDMX tonight — the swap takes you to 128.9.

case.label: The script that beats you
case.body: Golden stays benched past 19:00, Walker plays Thursday night, and Tuten sits without the fallback being made.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Walker ruled out before Thursday's 19:20 kickoff, or Tuten practising fully by Friday.
